source_selection.observation: Every threshold in [0.5, 0.2, 0.1, 0.05, 0.02] was exactly inert on both source-only validation folds; the predeclared conservative tie-break selected 0.5.

interpretation: Lowering the inherited native-edge threshold by 25x does not produce a usable second-daughter proposal after the fixed geometry, continuation and divergence guards. Further threshold sweeping is not justified; the next experiment must change edge/division training or candidate construction.
launch_failure_provenance: Two pre-target retries failed before source-score inspection or target inference. Their redirected paths were reused by the successful retry, so exact failure logs were overwritten; this limitation is recorded rather than presenting reconstructed text as an immutable log. Future launchers must use attempt-specific result directories.
